chain.label: Rudder post made of AISI 1025 carbon steel with low fatigue margin
chain.trigger: the rudder posts were made of American Iron and Steel Institute (AISI) 1025 carbon steel

chain.label: Certification basis addressed only static loads; 4130 substitution never mandated for in-service posts
chain.trigger: complied with the static load conditions required by the regulations in place at the time they were certified in the 1940s... AC 23-27 only addresses permissible material substitution for such rudder posts when replacement is needed

chain.label: Corrosion pits, scratches and surface roughness on rudder posts creating stress concentrations
chain.trigger: Corrosion, scratches, or surface roughness features were found on all five of the rudder posts

chain.label: Aftermarket beacon or strobe installed atop the rudder post adding mass and surface area
chain.trigger: All five of the rudders the NTSB evaluated had an aftermarket beacon or strobe installed on the top of the rudder post

chain.label: In-service gust and maneuver bending stresses exceed the 1025 steel endurance limit
chain.trigger: in-service stresses likely exceed the endurance limit for AISI 1025 carbon steel rudder posts that have corrosion, scratches, or surface roughness features

caused_by.evidence: the peak stresses on the nominal rudder post approach the endurance limit of AISI 1025 steel
These types of surface anomalies would result in a stress concentration that could cause the stress in a rudder post to exceed the endurance limit for AISI 1025 carbon steel
The additional surface area and mass of a beacon or strobe would likely increase the stresses even further
in service, the loading conditions on many parts of these airplanes' structures, including the rudders, are not static and contain dynamic alternating or repeated (fatigue) loads

chain.label: Fatigue fracture of the rudder post above the upper hinge
chain.trigger: the rudder post fractured above the upper hinge... likely fractured due to fatigue

caused_by.evidence: an AISI 1025 carbon steel rudder post exposed to loads approaching certification gust and maneuver limits would be more likely to fail due to fatigue
corrosion pits or scratches on the exterior surface were associated with fatigue origin areas on two of the examined rudder posts

chain.label: Top portion of the rudder folded over the upper tail brace wires
chain.trigger: the top portion of the rudder folded over the upper tail brace wires

caused_by.evidence: the rudder post fractured above the upper hinge and the top portion of the rudder folded over the upper tail brace wires

chain.label: Abrupt yaw and drastically diminished directional control requiring large rudder and forward yoke input
chain.trigger: the airplane yawed abruptly to the right... noticed drastically diminished control about the vertical axis. In addition, significant downward elevator pressure (forward control yoke) was required

caused_by.evidence: the top portion of the rudder folded over the upper tail brace wires, resulting in diminished control of the airplane

chain.label: Both airplanes substantially damaged but landed without further incident, no injuries
chain.trigger: sustained substantial damage when its rudder structurally failed in flight... He was able to land the airplane without further incident

caused_by.evidence: Uncertain that he could make a 180 degree turn due to the poor directional control, the flight instructor elected to return to the airport from which they had departed and landed without further incident
